messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-east-1 gateway. 5m error rate: 12% (baseline 0.3%).
Alex O.: paging oncall. Notified Mira and Sam. I'll start triage.
Mira K.: jumping in. Any initial signs?
Sam T.: seeing a big backlog on the batcher queue on master-scheduler-3. queue_length ~ 25k per shard. Dispatch delays > 4s.
Alex O.: confirm if it's HOL blocking or slow workers.
Sam T.: logs show many requests with long seq lengths (>= 8k tokens) causing batches to wait for larger items. HOL visible: small requests stuck behind 1 huge req.
Kevin Y.: adding some logs from batcher:```[batcher] enqueue_time=2026-03-14T12:08:21Z id=0x7f3 dispatch_delay_ms=4203 batch_size=64 max_seq=8200 kv_cache_miss=true```
Lisa SRE: gateway reports 504s and 502s. Upstream scheduler is timing out after 10s.
Alex O.: customer impact? CS-Jen any inbound?
CS-Jen: a handful of high-traffic customers reported timeouts and degraded latency. No data exfiltration. They see intermittent 502/gateway errors.
Mira K.: immediate mitigation options: 1) short-circuit oversized requests to a slow-path worker that doesn't block main batcher. 2) reduce batch window and max_batch_size to avoid HOL. 3) enable route fallback to rw-small quantized model for new requests.
Sam T.: I'm going to lower batch_window from 30ms -> 8ms on scheduler-*. That should reduce wait for huge sequences.
Alex O.: do it, Sam. Also add a per-request max_queue_time of 1500ms to drop requests that would stall others.
Sam T.: running command:```infractl scheduler update --name=master-scheduler --batch_window=8 --max_batch_size=32 --max_queue_time_ms=1500```
deploy-bot: rolling config update started for master-scheduler (3 pods).
Sam T.: watching metrics. queue_length per-shard dropping from 25k -> 6k in 90s.
Mira K.: enabling routing fallback for new traffic:```apictl set-route /v1/generate --fallback-model=rw-medium-quant --policy=latency-led```
Kevin Y.: also enabling KV cache warmup on a subset of nodes to reduce large-seq cold penalties.
Alex O.: FYI enabling fallback will change cost profile, tell billing if needed.
CS-Jen: notified affected customers that we have a mitigation and are investigating; we provided ETA 30m.
Sam T.: error rate down to 3.5% after batcher change + fallback. Still above baseline but improving.
Lisa SRE: some gateway 5xx still coming from scheduler timeouts when a worker OOMs on huge sequences. We should isolate and restart problematic worker pods.
Mira K.: identifying pods with repeated OOMs. Found master-scheduler-3-pod-2 showing oom_kill_count > 5.
Sam T.: cordon & drain that pod:```kubectl cordon master-scheduler-3-pod-2 && kubectl drain master-scheduler-3-pod-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
deploy-bot: recreate triggered for master-scheduler-3-pod-2 -> new instance master-scheduler-3-pod-5.
Sam T.: new pod healthy, warmup finished. queue length drops further. 5xx rate now 0.8%.
Alex O.: handing over to Mira for follow-up and postmortem. Summary posted in ticket: batching HOL caused by a mix of long-sequence requests + cold KV cache + too-large batch window. Immediate mitigations: lower batch_window, reduce max_batch_size, set max_queue_time, route fallback to quantized model, recycle OOMing worker.
Mira K.: taking over. I'll collect traces, add deterministic replay set, and file postmortem. Posting runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batcher-hol and https://redwood.internal/observability/traces/1768451234
CS-Jen: flagged top 3 affected customers and offered credits where SLA breached.
Kevin Y.: suggested medium-term fixes: implement elastic worker pool for long-seq jobs, per-request size-based routing, and KV cache pre-warming during traffic surges.
Mira K.: agreed. I'll open tickets for design and prioritization.
Alex O.: oncall clear from my side. Any outstanding action?
Sam T.: I'll keep an eye on the scheduler for 2 hours.
Mira K.: assigning postmortem owner Mira K., target draft in 72h. Incident status: mitigated, monitoring.
CS-Jen: customer updates sent, CS queue cleared.
incident-bot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1768451234
Mira K.: closing thread, will follow up with a formal postmortem in incidents/postmortems. Thanks team :thumbsup:
